tei:div.tei:p: tshogs pa sdai bzhir gyes tshul bzhugs so/ / na mo saṃ gha ya/ thub bstan rtsod ldan dus 'dir gsal mdzad pa'i/ /paṇa chen mkhan rgyud tshogs pa sdai bzhi'i khungs/ /ston pa sangs rgyas dngos slob shā ri'i bu/ /sgra can 'dzin gnyis klu sgrub ghu ma ti/ /ratna mi tra dharma pha la dang*/ /

ghu na pa ti chos 'phreng 'byung gnas sbas/ /des slob paṇa chen shākya shrī zhes pa| |ston pa sku 'das gsum stong nyi brgya dang*/ /lnga cu rtsa brgyad chu pho stag la bltams| |brgyad cu lnga bzhes me stag dbu ru phebs/ /lo grangs bcu gnyis bod du 'gro don mdzad/ /dgu cu bdun la rgya gar yul la byon/ /go dgu lcags pho 'brug la mya ngan 'das/ /paṇa chen thegs nas lo dgur tsang so bas/ / gdan gcig srol bskyangs der rting rdo rje dpal/ /sangs rgyas dpal nas gzhung pa dpon rgyal gyes/ /byes rdzing par grags de nas thugs rje dpal/ /dar ma dpal bzang gzhon nu bzang tshul dpal/ /sang gzhon dar zang tshul khrims mgon po ba/ /bsod 'od rin tshul bsod shes shes rab mgon/ / grags bsod sher 'phags sher tshul rin shes pa/ /chos dpal sher 'od kun dga' shes rab yun/ /rdor dpal man la mkhan rab nyer gnyis byon/ /paṇa chen me stag phebs nas ding sang gis/ /shing stag brgyad dkar dbus gnas yar chod la/ /lo grangs nyis brgya bzhi cu rtsa bdun song*/ /'tshal mig pa la mkhan po sangs rgyas dpal/ /'od dpal chos kyis rgyal mtshan sang rin pa/ / 'od dpal sher mgon seng rgyal bsod dbang dang*| |dran tshul tshul rin dpang blo rgyal dbang dang*/ /sras seng yon rin byang chub bzang po yan/ /bcu phrag phyed dang gnyis po ding sang dus/ /tshogs chen par grags thub bstan dri med kyis/ /srog 'dzin mkhan rgyud rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos lung thog ma lho grag byang chub dpal/ /bsod stobs sde dpal grags gzhon bsod nams grags/ /bsod bzang gzhon mgon mkhan chen grags rgyal dang*/ /grags tshul grags pa bshes gnyen rnam rgyal ba| |'jam dbyangs rin rgyal rgyal mchog grags dbang rgyal/ /zla blo rgyal ba phyag na ding sang yan/ /bcu phrag gcig dang drug cu byung bar grags/ /slab gsum rnam dag shākya'i bstan pa yi/ /gsal byed mkhan rgyud rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/

/dge 'dun sgang pa byang chub dpal nas gyes/ /dbang grags gzhon rgyal 'dul tsha don grub dpal/ /yon tan rgya mtsho dpal grub yon blo ba/ brtson rgyal seng ge dpal dang chos grub yan/ /bcu dang gcig gis 'gro kun smin grol la/ /'god mdzad mkhan rgyud rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /snyigs ma'i dus 'dir 'gro mang padmo'i gnyen/ / bod yul mun pa sel bar mdzad pa yis/ /paṇa chen mkhan rgyud rim pa'i 'od zer gyis/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa dar mdzad 'phrin las pa/ kha che paṇa chen slob rgyud 'di bris pas/ kha ba can 'dir thub bstan seng ges sgras/ kha na ma tho chos kun zil mnan nas/ kha tram gyi mtshon sku gsum myur thob shog / dge legs 'phel// // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ yig tshang mkhas pa dga' byed/tshogs pa sdai bzhir gyes tshul/ -PAGE 262--PAGE 261-
